LanguageData.ARIO_NpcWarBody: {0} and {1} have gone to war. Their quarrel is their own, but the fighting will weaken both and may redraw the map. Watch for marching hosts near their holdings.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcAllyJoinedBody: {0} has answered {1}'s call and declared against {2}. The war widens.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcRebellionBody: {0} has raised its banners against its liege, {1}. Victory may win independence; defeat will preserve the oath.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcLiegeChangedBody: {0} has abandoned {1} and sworn fealty to {2}.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcSubjugatedBody: {0} has submitted to {1} after defeat in war.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcIndependenceBody: {0} has defeated {1} and cast off its oath of fealty.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcAllianceBody: {0} and {1} have sworn an alliance against a common enemy. Each will answer the other's wars.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcCampaignBody: {0} marches on {1}, a holding of {2}. The matter should be settled within {3} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcCampaignTaken: {0} has taken {1} from {2}. The holding now answers to its new lord.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcCampaignRaided: {0} has broken the garrison of {1}, but {2} keeps the holding.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcCampaignRepulsed: {2} has repulsed {0} before {1}. The attackers withdrew with losses.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcWarCallBody: {0} is at war with {1} and calls on your House as {2}.\n\nMarching means declaring war on {1} yourself: their caravans, visitors and raids will treat you as an enemy until you make peace. Refusing costs honour and goodwill with {0}. You have {3} days to answer.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcWarJoinedBody: Your House has declared for {0} against {1}.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcWarDeclinedBody: {0} has been told that your House will not march. The slight is remembered.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcRecoveredTitle: Word from the realm is confused
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcRecoveredBody: Reports of the quarrel between {0} and {1} could not be confirmed, so nothing came of it. No land changed hands and no House was blamed. The matter may be raised again in about {2} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_PlunderClaimBody: {0} sends a raven over {1}. They will not go to war over it, but they want {2} silver for the smallfolk and the loss.\n\nPaying restores part of their goodwill and your standing. Refusing, or saying nothing for {3} days, costs honour and goodwill. Silver is taken from your keep.
LanguageData.ARIO_PlunderPaidBody: {0} has been paid {1} silver. The matter is closed.
LanguageData.ARIO_PlunderRefusedBody: {0} has been refused. The insult is remembered.
LanguageData.ARIO_PlunderIgnoredBody: {0} waited in vain for an answer about the sack. The silence is taken as a refusal.
LanguageData.ARIO_PlunderNoSilver: Your keep needs {0} silver to pay this claim.
LanguageData.ARIO_TaxOpinionHigh: Your taxes are heavy: your House loses about {0} honour and some House Integrity every {1} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_TaxOpinionLow: Your taxes are light: your House gains about {0} honour and some House Integrity every {1} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_TaxOpinionEven: Your taxes are what the smallfolk expect.
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcDebugCampaign: House: march an NPC host now
LanguageData.ARIO_NpcDebugUnavailable: No two Westerosi Houses are available for this.
